title: PhD funding and universities with no application fee
text: New PhD routes: ISTA's salaried PhD in Austria (apply by 8 January 2027), the Commonwealth PhD Scholarships for 17 countries including Nigeria, and the ANSO-CAS-TWAS/UNESCO PhD in China. The application-fee guide now lists 21 universities and colleges with no fee, among them Birmingham, Antwerp, Bates, Davidson and Grinnell.

title: Swiss master's funding and free US colleges
text: New: the Geneva Graduate Institute's master's scholarships (apply by 14 January 2027), the University of Geneva's Excellence Master Fellowships, the University of Lausanne's Master's Scholarship, and two US colleges that charge every student nothing: Curtis Institute of Music and Deep Springs College.

title: No. 1 in Education on the App Store in Ghana
text: On 8 November 2026 the DegreeStep iPhone app reached No. 1 among free Education apps on the App Store in Ghana. Thank you to everyone who downloaded it and shared it.

title: Penn and Manchester's Global Futures awards
text: New: the University of Pennsylvania, which meets full need for admitted international students, nursing BSN included, and Manchester's Global Futures Scholarships for Africa, £12,000 a year off a bachelor's or £19,000 off a master's for students from Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya and other listed countries.

title: Dutch, German, UK, Australian and Canadian awards
text: New: Maastricht's Brightlands Talent Scholarship, Radboud, Twente, Utrecht and VU Amsterdam awards, DAAD development courses at Flensburg and PH Ludwigsburg, Edinburgh Law School scholarships, UNSW's RTPI and UIPA, Western Sydney's Sydney City Campus award and Toronto's international Ontario Graduate Scholarship.

title: Eight more Erasmus Mundus master's, closing January to March
text: New: EMILDAI (17 January), i-MESC (26 January), EPOG and RE:Anima (27 January), FRP++ (31 January), EMLex (1 February), InterMaths (17 February) and ImAGEin (6 March). The tuition waiver guide now covers Glasgow's African Excellence Award and Erasmus Mundus fee waivers.

title: Nine more Erasmus Mundus master's with full scholarships
text: New: GLOBE (4 January), GrEnFIn (7 January), EDISS (12 January), GLOCAL (14 January), Euroculture, TERRA, MIPDaL and WAVES (15 January) and CLMCE (22 January). Each pays €1,400 a month plus fees for the best-ranked applicants of any nationality.

title: Eleven new scholarships, five closing by January
text: New: Wageningen's Africa Scholarship Programme and Anne van den Ban Fund (MSc application before 1 December), Mundus MAPP (1 December), EMMIR (20 December), Strathclyde's £10,000 January award (30 November), Glasgow's African Excellence Award, the Joint Japan/World Bank scholarship, and GREENANO, Human Response, STEPS and Mundus Journalism.

title: Denmark: tuition, application fees and waivers
text: New country guide: non-EU tuition at all eight Danish universities, from €7,450 a year at Aalborg, the €100 to €200 application fees and who is exempt, and the tuition waivers each university offers, most due by 15 January.

title: Eric Bleumink Fellowship at Groningen
text: New: the University of Groningen's Eric Bleumink Fellowship, a full master's scholarship for students from 79 developing countries. To be considered for September 2027, complete your Groningen master's application before 1 December.

title: OIST's funded PhD, 2 Lund positions and Voyager 1
text: New: the OIST PhD Program in Okinawa, which closes on 15 November and takes applicants with a bachelor's, and two salaried PhD posts at Lund University on Huntington's disease and on autonomous GIS. In the news: Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth on 18 November.

title: 2 new scholarships, 7 PhD positions and 4 stories
text: New scholarships: Imperial's President's PhD Scholarships and MBZUAI's funded AI degrees. New PhD positions: three at Max Planck Schools, closing 1 December, and four at Lund University. New stories cover those deadlines and a physics result from RHIC.

title: ASU's new Mastercard call and the Swedish Institute's 2027 dates
text: ASU's Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program now lists 50 online master's places based in Kigali, closing 22 November. The Swedish Institute's scholarship portal opens from 8 to 24 February 2027. Knight-Hennessy's 2028 application opens in summer 2027.

title: 5 new stories: UK Graduate visa, US student rule, ASU, Sweden and MIT
text: New in the news: the UK Graduate visa falls to 18 months from 1 January 2027, a US court has paused the four-year student rule, ASU and the Swedish Institute have new dates, and MIT has a new cancer vaccine approach in mice.

title: 9 tuition waivers added across Europe, and a Tuition Waiver filter
text: New on the board: Padua, Bocconi and the University of Calabria in Italy, Uppsala's Global and Anders Wall scholarships and Lund in Sweden, Aalto and Tampere in Finland, and Leiden in the Netherlands. The board has a Tuition Waiver filter, and a new guide lists every waiver by country.

title: Axel Adler Scholarship added, and the board now names each round
text: The University of Gothenburg's Axel Adler Scholarship waives tuition for a whole master's or eligible bachelor's programme: apply by 15 January 2027, then for the scholarship by 8 March. The departures board now says which round a date closes and when the next one comes, so an early deadline no longer reads as the school's last.

title: DegreeStep is on the App Store
text: The free DegreeStep iPhone app is out: scholarships filtered for your nationality, a countdown for every deadline and a working timeline you can add to your calendar. Download it from the new app page.

title: 4 more places with no application fee
text: Tulane University and Smith College charge first-year applicants no fee, the University of Melbourne charges none for graduate research courses, and Alliance Manchester Business School charges only for eight MSc courses. Austria's guide now answers whether university there is free for international students.

title: 5 new routes: Yenching, Weidenfeld-Hoffmann, EPFL, KTH and Stanford
text: Peking University's Yenching Academy (fully funded master's, apply by 30 November), Oxford's Weidenfeld-Hoffmann Scholarships (fees plus at least £21,805 for 188 countries, Ghana included), EPFL's Excellence Fellowships (CHF 10,000 a semester, by 15 December), the KTH Scholarship (full tuition, 1 December to 15 January) and Stanford's need-based aid.

title: Commonwealth Shared: Cameroon is not on the 2027–28 list
text: The who-can-apply check for Commonwealth Shared Scholarships now follows the CSC's 43 eligible countries for 2027–28; Cameroon is no longer listed. The UK guide also shows the 10 November to 8 December window.

title: Netherlands: fees at 11 universities of applied sciences, from €9,314
text: The Netherlands guide now lists non-EU bachelor's fees at 11 universities of applied sciences for 2026–27, the cheapest route into Dutch higher education: Windesheim €9,314, HAN from €9,320, Saxion €9,360 and HZ €9,893, against €13,200 or more at research universities.

title: 4 calls open for 2027: Commonwealth Shared, VLIR-UOS, Eiffel and Sweden
text: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships open on 10 November and close on 8 December 2026. VLIR-UOS has opened ICP Connect for 12 programmes at €1,400 a month. Eiffel nominations reach Campus France by 6 January 2027, after earlier university deadlines; its PhD allowance is €2,000 under the 2027 rules. Sweden's first round for autumn 2027 closes on 15 January.

title: Politecnico di Milano: a separate scholarship form by 15 December
text: The 2027-28 merit call needs its own form by noon Italian time on 15 December 2026, after an Early Bird application by 1 December; 64 awards add €2,500 to €10,000 to the tuition waiver. The Bologna, Helsinki, Romania, FU Berlin and Iceland pages now list fees, documents and FAQs.

title: 3 rounds closed in October
text: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships (20 October), Canada's doctoral research scholarships and the University of Queensland's international round (both 19 October) have closed, and their next rounds are not yet announced.

title: 7 new funded PhD posts at Lund and Uppsala
text: Four EU-funded doctoral posts in the sociology of law at Lund University, on Islam, law and governance in Central Asia, the Middle East and North Africa (apply by 31 January 2027), and three at Uppsala University: AI for wireless sensing, recycling solid-state battery electrolytes, and geophysics for exploration drilling.

title: 2 new full scholarships: Oxford's Clarendon and Belgium's VLIR-UOS
text: Clarendon pays full fees and a living grant for any Oxford master's or DPhil, open to every nationality, and you are considered when you apply for your course. VLIR-UOS ICP Connect scholarships fully fund a bachelor's or master's in Flanders for nationals of 25 countries in Africa, Asia and Latin America; the 2027–28 call is expected to open by the end of October.

title: Australia: 6 funded routes and a country guide
text: Australia Awards Scholarships, the Australian Government's Research Training Program, and research scholarships at the University of Melbourne, the University of Sydney, the University of Queensland and ANU, with a guide to Australian student visas, proof of funds, work rights and the Temporary Graduate visa.

title: 8 new routes in Africa and Asia
text: Japan's MEXT scholarship, Korea's GKS, the KAUST Fellowship in Saudi Arabia and the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship, plus Mastercard Foundation Scholars at the University of Cape Town, Ashesi University in Ghana, the AIMS master's and the African Union's Pan African University.

title: Deadlines and amounts updated across the board
text: New dates for Helsinki (5–19 January 2027), MIT (4 January), Dartmouth (1 January), the Canadian doctoral awards (19 October) and Mastercard Foundation Scholars at Cambridge. Maastricht's renamed NL-High Potential scholarship now pays €20,150 in living costs for a 13-month programme. Eiffel, Hungary and Türkiye show their 2027 calls as expected.

title: 8 new funded PhD posts at Uppsala University
text: Peace and conflict research, limnology, laser spectroscopy, developmental psychology, nuclear physics, organic chemistry, bioinformatics and perovskite solar cells, all salaried and open to every nationality.

title: Nobel Peace Prize 2026: Navi Pillay
text: Awarded to the South African judge and former UN human rights chief for her efforts to promote peace and international law.

title: NASA's next step on the LISA telescope
text: The final pre-flight test telescope for LISA, the ESA-led space observatory for gravitational waves due to launch in the mid-2030s.

title: Nobel Prize in Literature 2026: Anne Carson
text: Awarded to the Canadian poet and classicist for work in playful dialogue with the classical tradition that has created new forms for contemporary literature.

title: Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2026: Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai
text: Awarded for discovering how chemical reactions can produce mostly, or only, one of a molecule's two mirror-image forms.

title: Nobel Prize in Physics 2026: Francis Halzen
text: Awarded for the IceCube Neutrino Observatory at the South Pole and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos from beyond the solar system.

title: Two new guides for applicants from any country
text: Visa money, work hours and staying after graduation compared across ten countries, and how funded PhDs work in Europe: salaried posts, doctoral fellowships and scholarships, with a checklist for reading a PhD advert.

title: New: research and innovation news
text: A new page on the year's major research prizes and new funding, from the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine and the Fields Medals to the Kavli and Breakthrough Prizes.

title: New: funded PhD and research positions
text: A new page lists salaried PhD posts, doctoral fellowships and postdocs at Lund, Uppsala, Oslo, Copenhagen and ETH Zurich.

title: Country guides: visa money, work rights and staying after graduation
text: For all ten countries: the proof of funds for a student visa, the hours you may work, and how long you can stay to look for a job.

title: New route: Bowdoin College (USA)
text: Need-blind admission for international applicants, with 100% of calculated need met and no loans. Early Decision 1 closes on 15 November; Early Decision 2 and Regular Decision close on 5 January.

title: New route: Danish Government Scholarships
text: Tuition waivers and grants towards living costs for highly qualified non-EU/EEA students on full degree programmes. Each Danish university selects its own scholars and sets its own dates.

title: DAAD: doctoral rate in the EPOS call
text: DAAD's EPOS call lists €1,400 a month for doctoral candidates from February 2026, up from €1,300. Its general scholarship overview still lists €1,300.

title: TU Wien: non-EU application windows
text: The winter semester 2026/27 window for non-EU/EEA applicants closed on 15 July 2026. The summer semester 2027 window runs from 16 July 2026 to 15 January 2027.

title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars at ASU: 2027–28 call closed
text: Applications for the 2027–28 cohort closed on 27 September 2026 at 23:59 GMT.
